data.body:
Completion evidence, mapped to every acceptance criterion:

1. Proven runtime mechanism. In the failing pre-fix path, instrumentation at RunnerAgentStep observed prompt metadata loaded from the repository-selected root but prompt-body resolution called without that root, yielding an empty project-only system prompt. A second trace observed gate_dispatch compute cfg.repo_path for the attested snapshot while workflow repo_root, project-criterion membership, and batch validation received the original request root. The merged repair makes these values identical at src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py:190-191 and 245-250, and src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:654-677. Direct review now uses prompt_repo_root for both lookup and rendering at src/rebar/llm/operations.py:134-142 and 169-175. Spec scan does the same at src/rebar/llm/spec_scan.py:93-95 and 108-115.

2. RED/GREEN and mutation proof. Before the repair, the new snapshot/live sentinel tests failed because prompt content came from the wrong root; after the repair they pass. Reintroducing each defect-seeded mutation (omit repo_root from prompt rendering, pass request.repo_root to project criteria, or prefer the conflicting configured root for local mode) returned its corresponding test to RED, then restoring the repair returned it to GREEN. Concrete tests: tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py:133-174; tests/unit/test_code_review_gate_session.py:228-325 and 328-372; tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py:562-627 and 674-727. The CI follow-up mutation removed the attested test prompt commit at tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py:32-42 and reproduced FAIL unknown prompt; restoring it produced 2 passed.

3. Attribution through the production gate. tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py:559-588 drives produce_code_review_verdict through the production two-round workflow, proves the project prompt executes exactly once, then asserts the surviving finding reviewer_id is the physical project prompt and criteria includes the logical project id. Overlay-absent built-in parity is asserted at lines 591-610. The strict FIRE runtime fixture through the same four-pass workflow produced reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries] on the surfaced advisory.

4. Pass 3 posture. The strict FIRE runtime output carried block_threshold=0.9 and blocking_enabled=false. Production-gate and Pass-3 routing tests are tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py:687-750; overlay-absent disposition parity follows at lines 753 onward.

5. Historical report replication. Original artifact cd39-137e-0afd-490e from revision 8ac3d3c contained a built-in advisory and the project prompt hash, but that did not prove project-finder emission. After the repair, the unchanged revision completed prompt preflight and the full gate. Five isolated project-finder reruns all abstained, proving the historical clause is not a FIRE case. The strict FIRE control emitted and retained the required identity/posture. This kills the alternative hypothesis that clustering or Pass 3 strips identity.

6. Scope and safety. No review voting/process semantics changed and no dependency was added. The repair only threads the already-selected root consistently. Sibling sweep found and fixed the same metadata/body split in direct ticket review and spec scan. Existing built-in and no-overlay behavior remain covered.

7. Gates and landing. Focused touched-file suite: 97 passed. Full local default selection: 7313 passed, 29 skipped. make check passed. Gerrit change 991 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/991) merged as b3953a0da with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 from CI run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30328714833, and zero unresolved comments. origin/main now resolves to b3953a0da and the ticket trailer is reachable from this worktree HEAD.
